user.title: Add an SVG floor plan
user.description: Enter the path to an SVG file under the Home Assistant configuration directory. {details}

assign.title: Element {position}: {element_name}
assign.description:
Choose what to do with this SVG element. Its SVG ID is {element_id} and its type is <{tag}>.

Area: fill this shape with a color based on the selected sensor's temperature.
Value: replace this text with the selected sensor's reading.
Glow: add a soft temperature-colored glow that fades to transparent.

Turn on “Skip this element” to leave it unchanged. {details}

error.invalid_path: Enter a relative .svg path inside the Home Assistant configuration directory.
error.file_not_found: The SVG file was not found. Check the path and spelling.
error.file_read_error: The SVG file could not be read. Check the file permissions.
error.file_too_large: The SVG exceeds the 2 MB size limit.
error.malformed_xml: The file is not well-formed XML. Open it in an SVG editor and fix the reported XML error.
error.not_svg: The XML root element is not an SVG document.
error.invalid_metadata: The SVG has invalid Home Assistant metadata. Check entity IDs, element roles, and temperature settings.
error.unsupported_entity: The assigned entity must be a sensor or input number.
error.missing_role_id: Every element with a Home Assistant role must have an SVG ID.
error.missing_role: An entity group must contain an element with the area, value, or glow role.
error.invalid_temperature_range: Temperature thresholds must be numbers in increasing order: minimum, comfort, maximum.
error.invalid_color: Temperature colors must use six-digit hex values, for example #22C55E.
error.duplicate_ids: The SVG contains duplicate element IDs. Make each SVG ID unique.
error.render_failed: The SVG is valid, but Home Assistant could not render it as a PNG. Check the SVG features and bundled renderer logs.
error.no_assignable_elements: The SVG has no supported, identified shapes or text elements to assign. Add IDs to shapes or text in your SVG editor.
error.no_entity_assigned: Assign at least one Home Assistant entity before continuing.
error.entity_or_skip_required: Select an entity, or turn on “Skip this element” to leave this SVG element unchanged.

abort.already_configured: This SVG file is already configured.
